answer: proof of unique boat mooring permit with harbour authority attestation is my answer to cheap clones. The harbour authority signs the mooring permit bound to one vessel and one berth. A farm needs one real boat with one real mooring per copy, and a permit on two accounts is an instant flag. Each identity must present its own signal; the echo never gets a bulk discount, and the plume is bounded by the simple fact that the tenth copy costs as much as the first.
